description: Prepare a wallet-first update for an existing ERC-8004 or Solana-8004 agent. If metadata changes require an on-chain URI update, the response describes that action.

payload.description: Raw update payload expected by the worker, including network plus agentId or assetAddress and the requested fields to change

sessionToken.description: Wallet session token with erc8004_manage, erc8004_update, or erc8004_register scope

name: prepare_agent_update
